_meta.description: Curated code examples for the React Native SDK reference pages. Keyed by export name or page section.

CrossmintWalletProvider.note: CrossmintWalletProvider must be nested inside CrossmintProvider. showOtpSignerPrompt defaults to true in React Native, showing built-in OTP dialogs automatically. Set to false to handle signing flows manually via the useWalletOtpSigner hook.

ExportPrivateKeyButton.note: Only works with email and phone signers. Will not render for passkey or external wallet signers.

CrossmintAuthProvider.note: CrossmintAuthProvider must be nested inside CrossmintProvider. Set appSchema to your app's deep link scheme so OAuth redirects return to your app.

useCrossmintAuth.note: Must be used within a CrossmintAuthProvider.

CrossmintCheckoutProvider.note: CrossmintCheckoutProvider must be nested inside CrossmintProvider.

CrossmintEmbeddedCheckout.note: In React Native, when payment.crypto.enabled is true, you must provide a payment.crypto.payer object with the required callback handlers for signing transactions and switching chains.

CrossmintIdentityVerification.note: Keep the component mounted until `onComplete` or `onCancel`: the order leaves `requires-kyc`, and the hook returns undefined, before the flow shows its result. Handle `onCancel`, or the Done button on blocked screens does nothing. Pass the `appearance` object you give embedded checkout, so both look the same. Document capture needs camera access granted by the host app. On Android the WebView requests `android.permission.CAMERA` at runtime, which only succeeds if your app declares it in AndroidManifest.xml; on iOS you must set `NSCameraUsageDescription` in Info.plist. Neither is added for you.

rnOfframpProviderSetup.note: Add `CrossmintWalletProvider` only to pay from a Crossmint wallet. The offramp session needs a wallet owned by `userId:<USER_ID>`, where `<USER_ID>` is the `sub` of your auth provider's JWT. See [Use Your Own Auth Provider](/wallets/guides/bring-your-own-auth).

rnOfframpQuickExample.note: Create the session on your server with [Create Offramp Session](/offramp/api-reference/create-offramp-session), because it needs your server-side API key. Pass the `sessionId` and `clientSecret` it returns as `credentials`.

CrossmintEmbeddedOfframp.note: With `fill`, the component fills its container, so the container needs a definite height.

OfframpSignatureRejectedError.note: A payer for an external wallet. Throw `OfframpSignatureRejectedError` only when the user declined and nothing was broadcast.
